    Settings & help

    Compare stations

    The count under the area selector shows how many stations are in your area and how many are mapped across Bali. Choose All stations in this area and press Refresh area to check them together. There is no waiting period between different stations. Fresh results rank by the share of the sampled road reported slow or congested, then by congestion severity. Equal readings do not identify a quieter station.

    Choose 5 oldest checks to check up to five stations: unchecked first, then oldest successful readings. Recently checked stations are skipped. For just one station, open its details and press Refresh this station.

    Areas include nearby stations across neighbourhood boundaries. The catalogue combines mapped fuel stations and smaller fuel retailers; coverage is not exhaustive. An unchecked station stays “Not checked”.

    Each refresh measures one driving approach, up to its final kilometre. Both slow (orange) and congested (red) sections count. “No slowdown returned” is a neutral result, not proof that a road is clear. The timestamp is when the route service was queried.

    Google’s road traffic layer refreshes automatically while displayed. It can disagree with the route readings used for comparison. The app no longer draws green sampled lines over it. Select a station to see its named pin and the sampled approach as blue dots. Route readings change when you press Refresh; the 15-minute countdown is a refresh limit, not a waiting-time estimate.

    Traffic indicates road congestion, not a confirmed petrol queue or time at the pump. Junctions, through traffic and queues inside the forecourt can differ.

    Opening status & fuel

    Listed closed · unverified comes from a listing, not a visit to the station. Crisis opening hours may differ. These listings never exclude a station or override its traffic ranking.

    A green or red approach does not prove whether the pumps are operating. Opening and fuel availability remain unconfirmed without a recent firsthand report. Only a recent, explicitly sourced firsthand closure can affect the ranking; traffic refreshes never renew opening-report timestamps.

    Refresh limits & owner access

    The server verifies GitHub user ID 18115558 before calling Google. Other accounts and anonymous visitors cannot request paid traffic. The traffic API key stays on the server.

    Each station check uses one of 50 daily checks and 900 monthly checks, shared across all devices. These are server-enforced stop limits, including failed attempts. Checking one station uses one check; checking 15 uses 15. The button shows how many can be checked within the remaining budget. Rechecking the same station has a 15-minute cooldown; different stations can be checked immediately. Five traffic queries cost about US$0.075 after Google’s free allowance. Google also enforces project-wide limits of 50 route requests and 100 map loads per day. Unused route-matrix, 3D-map and grounding-widget quotas are zero. Google map displays have their own allowance. Provider quotas may reset at a different time from our Bali-day counter. Optional repeat checks run every 15 minutes while this tab is visible and pause when you change the area, search or refresh choice.

    A page reload does not make a paid traffic request. Previous results are held only in this page’s memory; failed readings retain their original times.

    Can we keep a traffic history?

    Google’s standard Routes terms restrict long-term storage of traffic results. These readings are therefore not archived to GitHub or a database. Historical charts need a data source licensed for storage, or independently collected observations. A private database would suit repeated measurements; GitHub continues to host the app and public station catalogue.

    Privacy, sources & terms

    Owner sign-in is shared with Bali Cinema Map on this GitHub Pages origin. Sign-out revokes this device session for both apps. Google traffic is held in memory, not saved to GitHub or browser storage. The server stores refresh counts and times.

    Your location is requested only when you press “Show stations near me”. It stays in this page and is used for distances; Google receives fixed station approach coordinates. Opening a station in Google Maps sends its public location, without your current location or a directions request.

    Expanded locations: © OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL. The original five locations and their dated opening listings came from Google Maps. Live traffic and its basemap: Google Maps. Public basemap: OpenFreeMap / OpenStreetMap.

    Google Maps use follows Google Maps terms and Google privacy policy. This independent tool does not guarantee opening, fuel availability or waits.
